rca_of_the_issue: Prior bug (iteration_69) had two causes: (a) frontend spread user_claimed_source='' into PATCH body — backend Literal type rejected with 422; (b) frontend catch block rendered the Pydantic error object array directly in JSX, crashing the React tree. Fix verified: MySupport.jsx saveEdit now filters empty/undefined values from payload (Object.fromEntries(...filter(v!=='' ...))) AND uses extractErr() which stringifies detail arrays via `.map(x => x?.msg || JSON.stringify(x)).join('; ')` so any future 422-shaped response renders as safe text in the StandingBanner instead of raw objects. Backend now has a defensive @field_validator on UserEditTicket that coerces '' → None so third-party clients don't hit the same footgun.
